analysisScope: Completed immutable reports only; no measurement, build, source or protocol edits
populationDefinition: All 20 registered seeds; null sorts after reached; index floor((N-1)*q). Worst is null when any seed is censored.
conditionalDefinition: Reached observations only; same lower-index quantile convention. Unreached retained in denominator.
units: seconds unless explicitly named minutes; bigint damage and power preserved as decimal strings; derived2h–12h event gaps subtract integer100ms ticks before returning decimal seconds
sameCandidatePairing: Required only for completed full12h reports;120min first-event censoring retained; no historical first-journey equality

validation.checks: Independent raw/manifest/file hash checks; archived source/evaluator/build digests; 20 canonical seeds; record/checkpoint consistency; conditional summaries and population target recomputation

archiveReproduction.sourcePathMapping: Round07 source tar entries must be root-relative, including all tsconfig files. No path remapping or archive mutation.
archiveReproduction.evaluationScope: Hash .harness/v7/** and docs/v0.7/EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.json exactly as evaluationDigest; extra archived DESIGN_DECISIONS.md is preserved but outside that digest.
archiveReproduction.executionSchema: Compare execution.experiment id/hypothesis/parameters plus execution.experimentKind with the full preregistration. Read logs, archives and raw only after execution.endedAt.
archiveReproduction.priorAnalysis: Round06 and earlier analysis originals remain separate. Archive lessons retained; old first-prefix equality intentionally removed.

selection.rule: Screening: population firstAccepted p50 2700..3600sec and >=18/20 by5400sec. Full12h: both plus population h70 eligibility p50 28800..43200sec. Rank by abs(first p50-3150), abs(final p50-36000), population first p90, ID.
